review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The role involves gathering and analyzing business requirements, assessing technical feasibility, preparing solution designs, and providing technical guidance throughout the implementation lifecycle. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in IBM DataPower, enterprise integration, middleware, and related security technologies, along with the ability to collaborate effectively with business and technical stakeholders. Responsibilities Attend business and technical meetings to gather and analyze business requirements. Requirements Strong understanding of SOA, enterprise integration, and middleware concepts. Hands-on experience in designing IBM DataPower integration solutions.
